summary: Added deskstats/timeparse.py with the specified public API and moved all date/time parsing and building from site, tickets, escalations, calls, chats, roster, closures, cli and report into it, keeping the other modules' public functions. The existing 13 tests pass, plus new tests in tests/test_timeparse.py. Old and new packages gave identical results on fuzzed inputs and on CLI runs over the samples and an odd site folder, under four TZ settings. Quirks kept as they were: roster two-digit years (0 becomes 2000, -5 becomes 1995), out-of-range epochs that raise OverflowError or OSError instead of ValueError and crash the run, and tickets.csv rows with a missing column crashing.
